newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's Alfa raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's Alfa raised.

text.p: ING Barings said in a report on Monday it raised its recommendation on Mexican conglomerate Alfa SA to buy from hold.
It said its price estimate for the company's shares was $8.78 for the next 12 months.

"We like Alfa's results, which have shown improvement not only in dollar terms, but in pesos, and its perspective, as the price pressures on its various products have eased," analyst Daniel Goldstein wrote in a report.
Alfa's prices in its petrochemicals division, Alpek, improved "dramatically," because of capacity growth. The company's steel division Hylsamex has also had encouraging results, Goldstein wrote.
The company's food unit, Sigma was boosted by a stronger peso, making raw material imports cheaper and improving margins.
Alfa's shares stood at 58.40 pesos in midday trade, up 0.40 peso from Friday's close.
